title: AI Vocabulary Generation with Text Input
description: Verify that the system generates approximately 100 contextually relevant AAC vocabulary words with accurate emoji associations and proper category distribution when user inputs a text description.

steps.description: Open the web app and enter a descriptive text context into the input field.
Submit the context to trigger vocabulary generation.
Check that around 100 vocabulary words are generated.
Verify that vocabulary words have correct associated emojis.
Ensure vocabulary terms are distributed across expected categories (Action/Task, Tech/Tool, Problem/Error, etc).

title: AI Vocabulary Generation with Image Upload
description: Validate that uploading a supported image format generates relevant context description and vocabulary within 5-10 seconds, including emoji integration.

steps.description: Open the web app and upload an image in JPEG format.
Verify image is accepted and processed.
Check that a context description is generated within 5-10 seconds.
Confirm approximately 100 vocabulary terms with emojis are presented based on image context.

title: Vocabulary Generation with Unsupported Image Format
description: Ensure the system handles unsupported or corrupted image formats gracefully with clear error messages.

steps.description: Attempt to upload an unsupported or corrupted image file.
Verify that the system rejects the image input.
Confirm that an informative error message is displayed without service disruption.

title: Drag-and-Drop Sentence Construction on Desktop
description: Verify smooth drag-and-drop interactions with mouse support for adding, reordering, and removing vocabulary words on the sentence canvas.

steps.description: Open vocabulary list on desktop browser.
Drag a vocabulary word onto the sentence canvas.
Confirm the word appears on the canvas.
Reorder words on the canvas by dragging.
Verify that words reorder correctly.
Remove a word from the canvas via drag off or delete button.
Confirm the word is removed from the canvas.

title: Drag-and-Drop Sentence Construction on Mobile/Tablet
description: Ensure touch and long-press drag functionality works for adding, reordering, and removing vocabulary on mobile/tablet with iOS/iPad optimizations.

steps.description: Open the app on a mobile or tablet device.
Perform long-press on a vocabulary word and drag it to the sentence area.
Verify the word is added to the canvas.
Reorder words in the sentence using touch drag-and-drop.
Confirm the order updates accordingly.
Remove words from the sentence using touch gestures or delete controls.
Ensure the word is removed successfully.

title: Custom Word Input into Sentence Canvas
description: Validate that users can type custom words not in the generated vocabulary directly into the canvas and these words can participate in sentence generation.

steps.description: Activate the input field on the sentence canvas.
Type a custom word not contained in the vocabulary list.
Add the custom word to the sentence.
Confirm custom word appears on the canvas.
Request sentence generation based on selected words including the custom word.
Verify generated sentences include the custom word appropriately.

title: Next Word Prediction API Functionality
description: Verify that next word prediction suggests up to 15 contextual next words with emojis dynamically within 1-2 seconds latency based on current sentence context.

steps.description: Construct a partial sentence on the canvas.
Observe the next word suggestions panel.
Check that up to 15 contextually relevant suggested words with emojis are displayed.
Verify the suggestions update dynamically within 2 seconds of sentence changes.

title: Sentence Generation with Selected Words
description: Ensure the sentence generation module produces 15-20 grammatically correct variations preserving core meaning from user-selected vocabulary words.

steps.description: Select a set of vocabulary words on the canvas.
Request sentence generation.
Verify that 15 to 20 sentence variations are generated.
Confirm sentences are grammatically correct and preserve the core meaning of selected words.

title: Text-to-Speech Playback for Words and Sentences
description: Validate that clicking words, suggestions, or sentences triggers immediate text-to-speech playback with user-selectable voice preferences.

steps.description: Select a vocabulary word and click its speech icon.
Confirm the word is read aloud instantly using Web Speech API.
Click on a generated sentence to play full sentence speech.
Verify the full sentence is read aloud immediately.
Change voice preferences in settings and repeat playback.
Validate the speech output uses the updated voice settings.

title: Search and Filter Vocabulary Terms
description: Check that search and filter functions respond in real-time, filtering vocabulary terms and categories with expandable/collapsible behavior.

steps.description: Enter a search string into the vocabulary search field.
Ensure vocabulary list filters dynamically to matching terms.
Use category filters or expand/collapse categories.
Verify categories expand or collapse accordingly and words are filtered properly.

title: Settings Panel Configuration and Persistence
description: Verify that user inputs in the settings panel (API key, dark mode toggle, font size, high contrast mode) are validated, applied immediately, and persisted in local storage.

steps.description: Open settings panel and enter a valid OpenAI API key.
Confirm API key is validated and accepted.
Toggle dark mode and high contrast mode.
Verify UI updates reflect chosen themes immediately.
Adjust font size settings.
Confirm font size changes are applied instantly.
Reload the app and open settings again.
Check that all previously selected settings persist from local storage.

title: API Key Validation Error Handling
description: Ensure that invalid or missing OpenAI API keys trigger clear error messages without disrupting core app functionality.

steps.description: Enter an invalid API key in the settings panel and submit.
Verify that a descriptive error message about invalid API key is displayed.
Confirm the app continues functioning with limited or default features.

title: Rate Limiting Behavior with API Key
description: Validate system behavior when API rate limit (20 requests per 5 minutes) is reached for a given API key, including error messaging and service continuity.

steps.description: Simulate sending 21+ requests with the same API key within 5 minutes.
Check that the 21st and subsequent requests return a rate limiting error.
Verify error messages clearly indicate rate limiting without crashing the app.

title: Accessibility Compliance Verification
description: Verify all interactive elements comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards including keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, touch target sizing, and color contrast.

steps.description: Navigate the app using keyboard only.
Confirm all interactive controls are reachable and operable.
Use a screen reader and test app navigation and element labeling.
Verify all UI elements have appropriate ARIA labels and roles.
Check that touch targets meet minimum size requirements.
Validate UI color contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards in all themes.

title: Performance Testing of Core Functionalities
description: Test performance targets to ensure vocabulary generation occurs within 15-30 seconds, image analysis within 5-10 seconds, sentence generation in 3-5 seconds, and speech playback is instantaneous.

steps.description: Trigger vocabulary generation from text input and measure response time.
Confirm vocabulary generation completes within 30 seconds.
Upload an image and record image context analysis duration.
Verify image analysis is completed within 10 seconds.
Request generation of sentence variations and time the completion.
Ensure sentence generation finishes within 5 seconds.
Activate text-to-speech on a word and on a sentence and measure latency.
Validate speech playback starts instantaneously.
